text:
Samir: Morning — quick heads-up: I updated the lane allocation rule to prefer AMS1 for low-priority batch jobs. Should relieve US-WEST pressure during weekday spikes. Monitoring for next 2 hours. (changed infra/alloc/policy.yaml)

Rachel: Link to PR?

Samir: https://redwood.internal/prs/8231 — small change, tests passed. Rollout started at 09:12 UTC. No canary because it's config-only but I'm watching.

Miguel: Observed immediate drop in queued jobs on us-west-2, nice. Spilled ~8 GPUs to AMS1, no errors so far. :thumbsup:

Olivia: Nice. Does this affect the warm pools mapping? We still have that ticket about az-mappings.csv ownership.

Samir: It reads mapping from s3://infra-config/az-mappings.csv; didn't change that. But we should double-check lane owners for AMS1/AMS2.

Kyla: FYI I filed INFRA-8421 to consolidate lane ownership and mapped the current owners in the ticket.

Rachel: Can someone drop the command to recreate the mapping locally? I'll run smoke tests.

Miguel: Run:
```
aws s3 cp s3://infra-config/az-mappings.csv ./az-mappings.csv
cat az-mappings.csv | jq -R -s -c 'split("\\n")[:-1]'
```

Olivia: I ran smoke against the new policy — noticed one job got routed to APAC1 even though it had us-west affinity. Suspect a fallback rule winning. Samir can you paste the snippet?

Samir: The fallback snippet I changed:
```
- name: prefer_ams1_lowprio
  when: request.priority == \"low\"
  prefer: [\"ams1\", \"ams2\"]
```

Samir: I added a guard so only 'batch' type requests get it. Shouldn't affect affinity-based requests.

Olivia: Got it. That explains it. I removed the test job and requeued — looks ok now.

Kyla: Quick quota note: Cloud quota team approved +12 GPUs in AMS for the month, pending tagging. I will add tags and ping finance.

Rachel: Great. Can we also get a short blurb for tonight's handoff? I'll post to ops-rotation.

Samir: Hand-off note: watch for increased AMS1 throughput; if latency spikes >250ms for interactive routes revert policy at /infra/alloc/policy.yaml:8231 (rollback command below).

Miguel: Rollback command I use:
```
git revert 8231 && ./deploy-scripts/apply-config --env prod --path infra/alloc/policy.yaml
```

deploy-bot: deploy started by Samir for PR 8231 — rollout id: rb-2026-03-17-09-12 — 2/3 regions updated.

Samir: Ping @Rachel and @Kyla for review on PR and ticket closure.

Rachel: On it, will review in 15.

Kyla: I'll update INFRA-8421 with quota tags and owner map after review.

Olivia: No further blockers from QA. Will watch logs for ~1h then sign off.

Miguel: Adding note: we should run a quick sweep of queued job size distribution tomorrow — saw a small bump in 8-16 GPU jobs that might affect packing.

Samir: Agreed, add to backlog or assign — I'll create a follow-up ticket.

Rachel: Thanks team. :raised_hands: 

Kyla: TY everyone.

Samir: closing the thread unless something pops up.
